verses.en: Brethren, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.
verses.pt: Irmãos, o bom desejo do meu coração, e a oração que faço a Deus por Israel, é que sejam salvos.
verses.en_web: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.
verses.en_bbe: Brothers, my heart's desire and my prayer to God for them is, that they may get salvation.

verses.en: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
verses.pt: Pois lhes dou testemunho de que eles têm zelo por Deus, mas não com entendimento.
verses.en_web: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
verses.en_bbe: For I give witness of them that they have a strong desire for God, but not with knowledge.

verses.en: For they being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.
verses.pt: Pois, como ignoraram a justiça de Deus, e procuraram estabelecer a sua própria justiça, eles não se sujeitaram à justiça de Deus.
verses.en_web: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.
verses.en_bbe: Because, not having knowledge of God's righteousness, and desiring to give effect to their righteousness, they have not put themselves under the righteousness of God.

verses.en: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
verses.pt: Porque o fim da Lei é Cristo, para justiça de todo aquele que crê.
verses.en_web: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.
verses.en_bbe: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to everyone who has faith.

verses.en: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.
verses.pt: Pois Moisés descreve a justiça que é pela Lei: “A pessoa que praticar estas coisas viverá por elas”. Levítico 18:5
verses.en_web: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”
verses.en_bbe: For Moses says that the man who does the righteousness which is of the law will get life by it.

verses.en: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)
verses.pt: Mas a justiça que é pela fé assim diz: “Não digas em teu coração: ‘Quem subirá ao céu?’ Deuteronômio 30:12 (Isto é, trazer Cristo abaixo),
verses.en_web: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down);
verses.en_bbe: But the righteousness which is of faith says these words, Say not in your heart, Who will go up to heaven? (that is, to make Christ come down:)

verses.en: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)
verses.pt: ou: ‘Quem descerá ao abismo?’” Deuteronômio 30:13 (Isto é, trazer Cristo dentre os mortos).
verses.en_web: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”
verses.en_bbe: Or, Who will go down into the deep? (that is, to make Christ come again from the dead:)

verses.en: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
verses.pt: Porém, o que diz? “A palavra está perto de ti, na tua boca, e no teu coração”. Deuteronômio 30:14 Esta é a palavra da fé, que pregamos.
verses.en_web: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth, and in your heart”; that is, the word of faith, which we preach:
verses.en_bbe: But what does it say? The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart: that is, the word of faith of which we are the preachers:

verses.en: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
verses.pt: Pois, se com a tua boca declarares que Jesus é Senhor, e em teu coração creres que Deus o ressuscitou dos mortos, serás salvo.
verses.en_web: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
verses.en_bbe: Because, if you say with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and have faith in your heart that God has made him come back from the dead, you will have salvation:

verses.en: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
verses.pt: Pois com o coração se crê para a justiça, e com a boca se confessa para a salvação.
verses.en_web: For with the heart, one believes unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
verses.en_bbe: For with the heart man has faith to get righteousness, and with the mouth he says that Jesus is Lord to get salvation.

verses.en: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
verses.pt: Porque a Escritura diz: “Todo aquele que nele crê não será envergonhado.” Isaías 28:16
verses.en_web: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”
verses.en_bbe: Because it is said in the holy Writings, Whoever has faith in him will not be shamed.

verses.en: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
verses.pt: Pois não há diferença entre judeu e grego, porque um mesmo é o Senhor de todos, rico para todos os que o invocam.
verses.en_web: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.
verses.en_bbe: And the Jew is not different from the Greek: for there is the same Lord of all, who is good to all who have hope in his name:

verses.en: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.pt: Pois: “Todo aquele que invocar o nome do Senhor será salvo.” Joel 2:32
verses.en_web: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
verses.en_bbe: Because, Whoever will give worship to the name of the Lord will get salvation.

verses.en: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
verses.pt: Mas como invocarão aquele em quem não creram? E como crerão naquele de quem não ouviram? E como ouvirão, sem haver quem pregue?
verses.en_web: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?
verses.en_bbe: But how will they give worship to him in whom they have no faith? and how will they have faith in him of whom they have not had news? and how will they have news without a preacher?

verses.en: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
verses.pt: E como pregarão, se não forem enviados? Como está escrito: “Como são agradáveis os pés dos que anunciam o evangelho da paz, dos que anunciam as boas novas!” Isaías 52:7
verses.en_web: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”
verses.en_bbe: And how will there be preachers if they are not sent? As it is said, How beautiful are the feet of those who give the glad news of good things.

verses.en: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?
verses.pt: Mas nem todos obedeceram ao evangelho, pois Isaías diz: “Senhor, quem creu na nossa pregação?” Isaías 53:1
verses.en_web: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”
verses.en_bbe: But they have not all given ear to the good news. For Isaiah says, Lord, who has had faith in our word?

verses.en: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
verses.pt: Portanto, a fé vem pelo ouvir, e o ouvir pela palavra de Deus.
verses.en_web: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
verses.en_bbe: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.

verses.en: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.
verses.pt: Mas pergunto: por acaso não ouviram? Sim, certamente. Pois: “Sua voz saiu por toda a terra, e suas palavras até os confins do mundo.” Salmos 19:4
verses.en_web: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”
verses.en_bbe: But I say, Did not the word come to their ears? Yes, certainly: Their sound has gone out into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world.

verses.en: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
verses.pt: Mas pergunto: por acaso Israel não entendeu? Primeiramente Moisés disse: “Eu vos provocarei ciúmes com os que não são do povo; com uma nação insensata vos provocarei à ira.” Deuteronômio 32:31
verses.en_web: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation, with a nation void of understanding I will make you angry.”
verses.en_bbe: But I say, Had Israel no knowledge? First Moses says, You will be moved to envy by that which is not a nation, and by a foolish people I will make you angry.

verses.en: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.
verses.pt: E Isaías ousou dizer: “Fui achado pelos que não me buscavam; fui revelado aos que por mim não perguntavam.” Isaías 65:1
verses.en_web: Isaiah is very bold, and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”
verses.en_bbe: And Isaiah says without fear, Those who were not searching for me made discovery of me; and I was seen by those whose hearts were turned away from me.

verses.en: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
verses.pt: Mas sobre Israel diz: “Todo o dia estendi as minhas mãos a um povo rebelde e hostil.” Isaías 65:2
verses.en_web: But as to Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”
verses.en_bbe: But about Israel he says; All the day my hands have been stretched out to a people whose hearts were turned away, and who put themselves against my word.
